question: footway centroids lon lat rounded
sql: SELECT id, ROUND(ST_X(ST_Centroid(geometry)), 5) AS lon, ROUND(ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geometry)), 5) AS lat FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'footway' LIMIT 10;

question: residential road geojson
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'residential' LIMIT 5;

question: tertiary road names WKT
sql: SELECT names.primary AS name, ST_AsText(geometry) AS wkt FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'tertiary' AND names.primary IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10;

question: paved 30 km/h roads formatted label
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, printf('%s - %s km/h', COALESCE(names.primary, 'Unnamed'), CAST(speed_limits[1].max_speed.value AS VARCHAR)) AS label FROM lisbon_roads WHERE road_surface[1].value = 'paved' AND speed_limits[1].max_speed.value = 30 LIMIT 10;

question: secondary road start points geojson
sql: SELECT id, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_StartPoint(geometry)) AS start_geojson FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'secondary' LIMIT 10;

question: service road centroids WKT
sql: SELECT id, ST_AsText(ST_Centroid(geometry)) AS centroid_wkt FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'service' LIMIT 10;
